title: Ferric Manipulations
subtitle: Ferric - blood remembers iron
text: Ferric temper is borne by practitioners who have worked extensively with metal: smiths, miners, soldiers. The two verbs, Blood Projection and Blood Absorption, are Ferric, and so is Conjure Staff, which calls your Living Staff to hand; see The Two Verbs. Blood Needle (CHARGED) hardens blood into iron barbs and looses them in a volley. Blood Needle Fan (CHARGED) scatters them wide. Blood Needle Lance (CHARGED) forges three piercing needles that pin, and held it gathers barbed needles round you, up to six: let go to loose them all, or click to loose one. Iron Retort (QUICK) raises a brief guard that lashes back at a melee attacker. Ironhearted (CHARGED) stores Iron Hearts that take damage first. Iron Choir (CONTINUOUS) intercepts shots with iron plates and looses needles at the nearest hostile. Lodestone Collapse (CHARGED) drags every enemy in reach into one point and crushes them. Sanguine Magnetism (QUICK) raises an iron pillar that pulls enemies in. Sculpting, Absorption: held toward dropped items it draws everything in reach to you. Ferric Rampart (QUICK) raises an iron wall. Sculpting, Projection: swept along the ground it raises the wall a block at a time along your path. Ferric Spikes (QUICK) drives up blood-iron blades, and held on the ground it sends a run of blades toward wherever you look, impaling what it passes under; click and it stands up where it is as blades that block the way. Sanguine Mending (CONTINUOUS) repairs the gear in your hand. Sculpting, Projection: held on a dropped tool or piece of armour, an injured golem or a worn anvil, it mends them. Vascular Dowsing (CONTINUOUS) reports the ore veins round you. Sculpting, Projection: drawn along a surface it cuts gouges. Lode Draw and Hematic Hewing have nothing to cast: through Projection the first crawls an ore lode and the second cuts tunnels and stairs; see Mining by Projection. Conjure Axe and Conjure Pickaxe reshape a held Living Staff. Hemorath's Crimson Tithe runs through Ferric blood as its second temper; see Canon Memories.
